summary: Parse /cpe/yourpayments/transactions from its __NEXT_DATA__ JSON (rows, paging cursor, upx token), falling back to the legacy DOM scrape, and page older rows with --since/--max-pages via the page's get-transactions XHR; a failed get-transactions page is an error, not the end of history, and --data-source local never pages live.
reason: The transactions page is now a Next.js app with no apx-transactions-* DOM, so ParseTransactions returned no rows (`transactions` printed null). Older rows load only through POST /payments-portal/data/iris/live/v1/data/manage/get-transactions with x-amzn-upx-token from pageProps.token and exclusiveStartKey set to the previous lastEvaluatedKey; session cookies alone are rejected.
validated_outcome: Against a live US account, `transactions --since <~3 months>` paged 7 XHR pages and returned the same 130 charges/refunds as the browser's infinite scroll; plain `transactions` returns the first 20 rows (previously null).
